description: OpenSwarm main/settings window permissions (all platforms). Deliberately NO `remote` block: daemon-served pages never call Tauri IPC (only the bundled settings.html does, from the tauri asset origin), so granting IPC to any http(s) origin would only widen the surface — an iframe of an arbitrary origin embedded in a trusted page would pass capability matching while Rust-side checks authenticate the top-level WebView URL.
